page_title: FunNotch — a free Dynamic Island for your MacBook’s notch

summary.name: FunNotch
summary.one_liner: FunNotch is a free, open-source macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style panel for music, files, clipboard history, focus sessions and widgets.
use_cases: Control Apple Music, Spotify or browser media from the notch
Keep files on a temporary shelf and share them via AirDrop
Run Pomodoro or focus sessions with app and website blocking
Replace the macOS volume and brightness overlay
See calendar events and meeting join links in the notch
summary.what_it_does: FunNotch expands the MacBook notch into an interactive panel when you hover over it. It shows music artwork, a scrubber and playback controls for Apple Music, Spotify and browser media. A file shelf lets you drop files toward the notch and share them via AirDrop. Clipboard history is searchable for text and images, with pinning. Focus sessions and Pomodoro cycles show a countdown and can block distracting apps and websites. It also replaces the volume, brightness and keyboard backlight overlays and offers thirteen closed-notch widgets.
notable: Free and open source under GPL-3.0, no account or analytics
Focus sessions that block apps and websites
Compared against BoringNotch, NotchNook and Alcove on the page
caveats: Current build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple, so macOS may require manual approval in Privacy & Security
Some browser media controls need Automation permission and 'Allow JavaScript from Apple Events'
